necessary_context.content: On curvature -1 hyperbolic space H^d, F_d(R,L) consists of globally geodesically convex, globally L-Lipschitz real-valued functions with a global minimizer in the closed localization ball. The exact Oracle is a fixed selection x -> (f(x),g_f(x)) satisfying the global support inequality at every x. Q*(R,epsilon)=sup_{d>=2} Q*_d(R,epsilon).
necessary_context.name: Function class and Oracle Model

necessary_context.content: Section 3.3 reports g'=k^2 g, R=kr, L'=L/k and selected subgradient h'=h/k^2 for curvature -k^2. The normalization preserves epsilon Lr and the Oracle support inequality. No separate local transfer Theorem is asserted here.
